claim.summary: Express-style HTML response concatenation is absent from bounded HTML sinks

evidence.sandbox: Offline disposable Linux container; no host mounts/secrets; read-only root; uid 65532; 4 CPUs; 4 GiB RAM; 256 processes; 3 GiB work + 256 MiB tmp; 30 minute lifetime; tests bounded to 300 seconds
assumptions: Source fixtures are parsed only, never executed
evidence.original_result: Original three-test harness: 0 passed, 3 failed; all ten affected credential declaration forms missed

verification.method: Same original cases plus negative regressions and full Rust suite

limitations: Candidates are heuristic, not vulnerability verdicts
Coverage is bounded to tested syntax and modeled source/sink names
